info.description: BDT minor-unit pricing. Register/login, copy accessToken into Authorize, then try protected routes. Admin/staff login requires MFA. Mutating commerce commands require Idempotency-Key. Use expectedVersion from the latest resource. GET checkout/options lists configured payment methods. See README for the full test flow.
